SELECT STATION_NO , STATION_NAME , STATION_ADDRESS , STATION_TYPE , REGISTER_DATE , STATUS , STATION_COUNT , USEABLE_STATION FROM TB_STATION WHERE STATUS = 'Y'
AND STATION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{stationName} || '%'
AND STATION_ADDRESS LIKE '%' || #{stationAddress} || '%'
AND STATION_TYPE = #{stationType}
ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE DESC

SELECT STATION_NO, STATION_NAME, STATION_ADDRESS, STATION_TYPE, STATION_LNG, STATION_LAT REGISTER_DATE, STATUS, STATION_COUNT, USEABLE_STATION FROM TB_STATION WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE DESC
SELECT STATION_NO, STATION_NAME, STATION_ADDRESS, STATION_TYPE, REGISTER_DATE, STATUS, STATION_COUNT, USEABLE_STATION FROM TB_STATION WHERE STATION_NO = #{stationNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT REVIEW_NO, STATION_NO, REVIEW_TITLE, REVIEW_CONTENT, STATUS, REVIEW_DATE, MEMBER_NO FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE STATION_NO = #{stationNo} AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REVIEW_DATE DESC
